clauses.statement: The enforced weight-independence axis is agent_system only (codex vs claude_code), never --agent-model; judgment-DAG adjudicate record --judgment and adjudicate correct must reject an --agent-system equal to the story's recorded implementation-provenance agent_system before any persistence, unless --allow-same-system <reason> is supplied or an accepted gate:judgment_dag_adjudication:same_system_environment decision exists.
clauses.rationale: An adjudicator sharing the implementer's model family shares its training-distribution priors, so plausible-but-wrong patterns are judged sound for the same reason the implementer believed them correct; the independent-verification error product only holds across a genuinely different weight family.

clauses.statement: AC-3: on the judgment-DAG path, adjudicate record --judgment and adjudicate correct with an --agent-system equal to the recorded implementation system are rejected before persistence unless --allow-same-system <reason> is provided; the granted override reason is appended to the append-only log .vibepro/adjudication/<story-id>/same-system-log.jsonl and stored on the persisted event's provenance.

diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Provenance[adjudicate provenance --agent-system] --> Store[implementation-provenance.json]
  Store --> Evidence[adjudicate record evidence path]
  Evidence --> WarnOnly[same_system warning, never blocks]
  Store --> Judgment[adjudicate record --judgment / adjudicate correct]
  Judgment --> Compare{agent_system == implementation_system?}
  Compare -- no --> Persist[verdict/correction persisted]
  Compare -- yes --> Override{--allow-same-system or accepted decision?}
  Override -- no --> Reject[rejected before persistence]
  Override -- yes, flag --> Log[same-system-log.jsonl append + event provenance] --> Persist
  Override -- yes, decision --> WarnPersist[warning + persist] --> Persist
diagrams.rationale: Shows the two independent enforcement branches (evidence-path warning-only vs judgment-DAG hard reject) both keyed off the same implementation-provenance record.

diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Attacker[Same-model-family adjudicator judging its own implementer's plausible-but-wrong pattern] --> T1[Threat: weight-correlated verdict passes judgment-DAG as judged_sound]
  T1 --> M1[Mitigation: enforceCrossSystemAdjudicator rejects agent_system == implementation_system before persistence on the judgment-DAG route]
  Attacker --> T2[Threat: silent bypass via undocumented override]
  T2 --> M2[Mitigation: --allow-same-system reason is appended to append-only same-system-log.jsonl and stored on the persisted event provenance, never a silent skip]
  Attacker --> T3[Threat: config flag makes same-system passes an implicit default]
  T3 --> M3[Mitigation: no global disable switch; only a per-story accepted decision record with source gate:judgment_dag_adjudication:same_system_environment, requiring reason and artifact, downgrades to a warning]
  Attacker --> T4[Threat: missing provenance silently disables the axis]
  T4 --> M4[Mitigation: provenance_missing is an explicit warning on every judgment-DAG record, visible in the persisted event, not a silent no-op]
diagrams.rationale: The security-relevant surface is adjudicator independence itself: the story closes a specific bypass (same-weight-family judging) without opening a new one (silent overrides or implicit same-system defaults).
